description.value: Nature's Fare Markets is a health-focused natural food supermarket chain with a location in White Rock, BC, opened in 2016. The store stocks certified organic produce, ethically sourced meat and dairy, vitamins, and a wide range of dietary-specific products (vegan, keto, gluten-free, paleo). An in-store Bistro and grab-and-go section offer smoothies, salads, entrees, and breakfast items for cyclists looking for a quality food stop.

address.value: 15180 North Bluff Road, White Rock, BC V4B 3E5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the store is active at the OSM address and phone number. The store page lists grab-and-go salads, entrees, breakfast, and smoothies alongside a named Bistro, confirming hot/prepared food. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, or any cycling-specific infrastructure anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM address missing postal code; website confirms V4B 3E5 — address updated to include it.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate health food supermarket with a Bistro and grab-and-go meals; a useful provisioning stop for touring cyclists in White Rock. Bike parking could not be confirmed but the grocery and food offering is strong.
enrichment_extras.notes: Free parking and both indoor and outdoor sitting areas noted on store page. Seniors Day is Wednesday and Thursday (not cycling-relevant but confirms active community programming).

Hot food.detail: In-store Bistro serving 'local, organic and sustainable foods and drinks'; grab-and-go salads, entrees, breakfast, and smoothies listed on store page
